speaker: Doctor
text: I see you are experiencing agitation and a yellowish tint to your skin and eyes. Can you tell me if you have had any recent abdominal pain, fever, or nausea? Also, do you have a history of liver disease or do you consume alcohol regularly?

speaker: Patient
text: 20-year-old male. The patient was previously healthy and has been brought to the emergency department due to agitation over the past 24 hours. Family members have noticed a yellowish coloring of his skin and eyes over the past week. The patient has a history of occasional cocaine and ecstasy use, and drinks alcohol socially on weekends. The patient also admits to high-risk sexual behaviors without using appropriate protection.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your high-risk sexual history and recent onset of jaundice, have you experienced any dark urine, pale stools, or loss of appetite in the past week? I would like to rule out acute viral hepatitis. REQUEST TEST: Hepatitis Panel (A, B, C), Liver Function Tests, CBC
